description: Default (cross-platform) capabilities for Corvux. The fs plugin is not registered and no fs:* permissions are granted — every roost read/write goes through a Rust IPC command (commands/files.rs), which enforces RoostFs path scoping. The renderer cannot reach disk except via those IPC commands. Do not add fs:* permissions without an audit. Mobile-only plugin permissions (saf, multicast-lock, ios-picker) live in mobile.json; desktop-only ones live in desktop.json.
